mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quotes ( id, quote_number, origin_locode, destination_locode, requested_arrival_date, cargo_type, weight_kg, created_at ) VALUES ( #{row.id}, #{row.quoteNumber}, #{row.originLocode}, #{row.destinationLocode}, #{row.requestedArrivalDate}, #{row.cargoType}, #{row.weightKg}, #{row.createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, quote_number, origin_locode, destination_locode, requested_arrival_date, cargo_type, weight_kg, created_at FROM quotes WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, quote_id, voyage_number, via_locodes, transit_days, estimated_price, sort_order FROM quote_route_options WHERE quote_id = #{quoteId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC
SELECT id, quote_number, origin_locode, destination_locode, requested_arrival_date, cargo_type, weight_kg, created_at FROM quotes ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
